title: Composed supervisory control: Qualified event capture with saturation -> Qualified dual-edge recorder with saturation and re-arm

inputs.name: A_MaxCount
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Saturation limit, assumed at least one

outputs.name: A_AcceptedPulse
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Accepted event this scan

outputs.name: A_AtLimit
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Count has reached MaxCount

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: A_MaxCount is constant during a test and is at least 1.
Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: B_MaxCount remains constant during a test.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall clear A_Count and A_AcceptedPulse.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Only a rising A_Event edge with A_Qualify TRUE and A_Count below A_MaxCount shall increment A_Count.
requirements.property: G(A_AcceptedPulse = (rose(A_Event) AND A_Qualify AND (prev(A_Count) < A_MaxCount) AND !A_Reset))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Count shall not exceed A_MaxCount.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_AtLimit shall be TRUE exactly when A_Count is at least A_MaxCount.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Only a qualified, non-inhibited rising edge observed while not previously B_Locked may be accepted.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_PulseA OR B_PulseB) -> (B_Qualify AND !B_Inhibit AND !prev(B_Locked))))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Simultaneous eligible edges shall accept A only.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((rose(B_EventA) AND rose(B_EventB) AND eligible) -> (B_PulseA AND !B_PulseB)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Each accepted event increments B_Count once and records B_LastSource.

While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Except for a qualified B_Reset scan, B_Count shall saturate at B_MaxCount and latch B_Locked; B_MaxCount less than or equal to zero locks without counting.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (((B_Count>=B_MaxCount OR B_MaxCount<=0) AND !(B_Reset AND !B_EventA AND !B_EventB))->B_Locked))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: A held-high event shall not retrigger until observed low and then rising again.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_EventA AND prev(B_EventA))->!B_PulseA)) AND G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_EventB AND prev(B_EventB))->!B_PulseB))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset clears B_Count, B_Locked, and B_LastSource only while both events are low.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_Reset AND !B_EventA AND !B_EventB)->(B_Count=0 AND !B_Locked AND B_LastSource=0)))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_AcceptedPulse shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_PulseA AND NOT B_PulseB AND B_Count=0 AND NOT B_Locked AND B_LastSource=0)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_PulseA AND NOT B_PulseB AND B_Count=0 AND NOT B_Locked AND B_LastSource=0))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
